Accountant Job at Prohuman Capital Consulting




        
    

        
        
     

            
    

Prohuman Capital Consulting is a dynamic HR consulting firm dedicated to empowering organizations with comprehensive human resources expertise and strategic guidance. Founded on the principle that exceptional talent management drives business success, we partner with companies to navigate their most complex HR challenges and unlock their human capital potential. Our reach extends to companies in and around West Africa, where we do business with diverse organizations seeking strategic HR solutions. At Prohuman Capital Consulting, we believe that every organization is unique. Our consultative approach begins with understanding your specific business context, industry dynamics, and organizational culture. We then develop customized solutions that are practical, implementable, and measurable.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Accountant 

Job Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking to engage a diligent, detail-oriented, and commercially aware Accountant to manage the company's financial operations.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, managing payroll, tax compliance, client invoicing, project cost tracking, and providing timely financial reports to management. This role is critical to ensuring financial discipline as the company scales its operations across multiple service lines.


Key Responsibilities


	Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records and prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
	Manage accounts payable and receivable, including vendor payments, staff expense claims, and client invoicing.
	Process payroll and ensure timely remittance of statutory deductions, including PAYE, Pension, NSITF, and NHF.
	Manage tax compliance, including CIT, VAT, and WHT filings, while ensuring adherence to relevant regulations.
	Track project costs against budgets, prepare job cost reports, and highlight variances for management review.
	Perform bank reconciliations, manage petty cash and cash flow, maintain financial controls and documentation, and support budgeting, audits, and financial planning.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
	2–4 years of relevant accounting experience.
	ICAN, ACA, or ACCA qualification (or student membership with proven progression for junior candidates).
	Experience in engineering, construction, oil & gas, or other project-based organisations is an added advantage.
	Proficiency in Sage, QuickBooks, or similar accounting software, with strong Microsoft Excel skills.
	Good knowledge of Nigerian tax laws and statutory compliance.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Accountant" as the subject of the email.

Head of Department Job at Godfrey Okoye University Teaching Hospital




        
    

        
        Godfrey Okoye University Teaching Hospital (GOUNITH), formerly Ntasi Obi Hospital, is a premier university teaching hospital, that stands at the vibrant intersection of research, education, and patient care. This unique synergy allows us to deliver exceptional, compassionate care while constantly innovating and advancing the field of medicine.

We believe in a holistic approach to wellness. We are more than just a hospital; we are a hub of medical excellence where every patient visit contributes to a new generation of healthcare leaders.

Applications are invited from suitable candidates to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Head of Department 
     

            
    



Job Location: Enugu
Job type: Full-time
Department: Environmental Health, Sanitation and Works

Qualifications


	B.Sc/ HND in Environmental Health Science with at least 6 years post qualification cognate experience
	West African Health Examination Board Certificate
	Current practicing license from the Environmental Health Council of Nigeria
	NYSC discharge or exemption certificate.


General Requirements
Applicants must:


	Possess the prescribed academic and professional qualifications relevant to the position applied for.
	Be duly registered with the appropriate professional regulatory body, where applicable
	Possess a valid practicing license where required.
	Demonstrate relevant post-qualification experience and professional competence.
	Exhibit integrity, excellent interpersonal skills, and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary healthcare environment. 
	Must be ICT compliant.


Remuneration
The new salary scale is very attractive.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should submit a formal application addressed to:
The Registrar,
Godfrey Okoye University Teaching Hospital (GOUNITH),
Thinker's Corner, Enugu State.
And
Applications should also be forwarded to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email. 

Application documents should contain the following listed below:


	A detailed and up-to-date Curriculum Vitae (CV) Copies of academic and professional certificates.
	Names and addresses of three (3) referees, one of whom should be the applicant's current or most recent employer.


Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for interview.

Customer Experience Analyst Job at Venco




        
    

        
        Venco is an all-in-one community management platform powering billing, utilities, payments, and access control across approximately 600 residential communities in Nigeria, Kenya, and Ghana. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Experience Analyst

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

The Opportunity
     

            
    




	We are looking for a Customer Experience Analyst to support Venco’s customer experience function by analysing customer interactions, feedback, complaints, service performance, and customer behaviour to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
	This is a hands-on analytical role for someone who enjoys working with customer data, identifying problems, and turning insights into practical improvements. An understanding of PropTech, real estate management, SaaS, or related industries will be an advantage.
	The role will be responsible for maintaining accurate CX data, monitoring key customer experience metrics, preparing reports, and providing actionable insights that support better decision-making, service delivery, and customer satisfaction.


What You’ll Do


	Analyse customer feedback, complaints, interactions, and service data
	Monitor CX metrics such as CSAT, NPS, response time, and resolution time
	Identify friction points across customer journeys
	Track recurring issues and recommend improvements
	Build reports and dashboards to support decision-making
	Work closely with Customer Experience, Operations, Product, Engineering, Finance, and other teams
	Use AI and digital tools to improve research, analysis, reporting, and productivity


Requirements
What we’re looking for:


	2–4 years of experience in Customer Experience, Customer Success, Business/Data Analysis, Customer Support, Operations, or a related field
	Strong analytical, problem-solving, reporting, and communication skills
	Good knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets
	Experience with CRM or customer support systems
	Experience in SaaS, PropTech, FinTech, Real Estate, Utilities, or a related industry is an advantage
	This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, customers, and cross-functional teams and wants to contribute to measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, service quality, and the overall customer experience.


Salary
N350,000 - N450,000 / Month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letter to [email protected] using “Customer Experience Analyst” as the subject of the email.
